# Sign-off and commit identities for the DCO check (CONTRIBUTING section 11;
# P1-n, P1-p).
#
# This file is read from the trusted checkout of the target branch only, so a
# pull request that edits it is still judged by the target branch's copy. One
# identity per line as "<role> Name <e-mail>"; blank lines and lines starting
# with # are ignored, and any other line fails the check instead of being
# skipped.
#
#   signoff  may sign the squash-merge message in the pull request body; a
#            sign-off identity is also exempt from per-commit sign-offs.
#   author   maintainer-owned commit identity (agents commit with this one);
#            exempt from per-commit sign-offs in same-repository pull requests,
#            but not allowed to sign the body.
#
# Two identities may sign the pull request body: the maintainer, and the human
# collaborator the maintainer has authorised (Ankar). A signature is the
# signer's DCO 1.1 confirmation for that contribution. Agents commit with the
# maintainer's local Git identity, add no Signed-off-by themselves, and never
# sign the body. A sign-off only clears the merge check; which role may merge
# is unchanged (CONTRIBUTING section 11).
signoff inpac <inpac@lingmatrix.cn>
signoff Ankar <ankarnassia@lingmatrix.cn>
author inPac <tenneidp@gmail.com>
